reading_scope: All selected full HTML bodies and code blocks were loaded and checked to EOF, with title/opening/closing/topic inspection. New PDFs were checked at title, abstract, introduction and actual conclusion. This is archival/identity verification, not experiment reproduction.
offline_scope: All 47 article/document bodies and all 343 effective body-image references are local. Duplicate noscript fallback image tags are excluded. Native MathML and pre-rendered SVG formulae are retained. Video/audio, interactive widgets and arbitrary external pages/repositories are not packaged. Code snippets are historical source material and were not executed.
deduplication: Duplicate source URLs normalized across the two user lists. Distinct PyTorch and Together FA3 republications are both retained and labeled, without counting them as distinct papers. Image bytes are globally deduplicated by SHA-256.
file_preservation: All 576 starting PDFs, existing HTML snapshots and historical manifests are preserved. New assets are content-addressed; seven SVG external DTD headers are removed without editing the drawing data.

publication_scope.archived_source_whitespace_policy: Preserve source PDF/SVG bytes, code whitespace and native MathML annotations. Whole-tree git diff --check reports 1074 source-artifact whitespace diagnostics: 938 from a byte-preserved PDF treated by Git as text, 4 from source SVG bytes, 128 from preserved code and 4 from MathML annotations. No unexplained diagnostics; authored navigation and metadata pass their whitespace check.
